public.heroTitle: Catch the attack the signatures miss.
public.heroSubtitle: Two-stage hybrid screening pairs unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly detection with supervised LightGBM classification for high-volume network telemetry.
public.stage1Desc: Unsupervised anomaly detection screens high-volume network telemetry, isolating anomalous flows above the 0.50 cutoff without signature lag.
public.stage2Desc: Supervised gradient boosting classifies flagged anomalies into specific attack families (DoS, Probe, R2L, U2R) with calibrated probabilities.
public.stage3Desc: Human-in-the-loop forensic triage, MITRE ATT&CK killchain mapping, and analyst feedback loop for model retraining.
public.triStateDesc: Structured operational actions executed by security operations center analysts upon alert review.
public.truePositiveDesc: Confirmed intrusion attempt matching LightGBM class (DoS, Probe, R2L, U2R). Flagged for perimeter blocklist escalation. Flow archived for model retraining.
public.falsePositiveDesc: Benign statistical anomaly caused by legitimate administrative network maintenance or backup batch. Flow labeled as negative sample to tune decision boundary.
public.escalatedDesc: High-confidence novel intrusion or unclassified lateral movement requiring Tier 2 deep packet inspection and endpoint containment.
public.aboutTeamDesc: Built for Microsoft Innovate 2026. Security Operations theme.
